grh_4e7db1c37bc69d6e4364.title: Blossom Otoole
paragraphs: Years after young Claire Barnes ran away when her stern father refused to accept her love for Harry Hall, Dr. Christian learns that the now-elderly Barnes is dying and sends for the daughter he has never stopped missing. Claire returns as Blossom O'Toole, the stage name she adopted after leaving home. She admits to Christian that she and Harry never married and that her hoped-for theatrical success never came; Blossom is only a struggling second-rate actress. She is ashamed to let her father know how little came of the life she chose, but Christian persuades her to see him. At his bedside Claire allows the dying man to believe that she is happy and successful, giving him the comfort and pride he needs in his final moments. The reunion lets father and daughter make peace without forcing Claire to destroy the image that eases his death.

grh_4e02586b147c09d29a15.title: Blood Relations
paragraphs: Britt returns to the Wilcox ranch to help George Wilcox with a cattle drive and finds George determined to stop his sister Viola from marrying Hunt Coffin simply because Hunt's brother was a criminal. George's efforts escalate from striking Viola to aiming a rifle at Hunt when he comes for her. Viola shoots George in the arm before he can fire and turns his argument about 'bad blood' back on him, then leaves with Hunt. paragraphs: Englishman Rudolf Rassendyll arrives in Ruritania and, because he is nearly identical to King Rudolf, is forced to impersonate the monarch after the king is drugged and kidnapped by the ambitious Black Michael. paragraphs: A dramatization of Wanda Wasilewska's The Rainbow depicts a Ukrainian village under Nazi occupation and the resistance growing around it.
